verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a Workflow Designer for publishing workflow designs (docs-8, docs-16) and says the platform owns approval and signature policies (docs-15). It also lets integrations block or push forward approvals within the contract process (docs-20), so the core of routing contracts through approvals before signature is evidenced. missing for 10: first-party detail on configuring approval steps (approver assignment, conditional routing rules, sequencing), plus independent or hands-on corroboration of approval workflows.
